_wg_domains_doc: systemd-resolved routing domains for wg0. MUST mirror the Hickory mesh zones [diegonmarcos.com, app, db] exactly, and MUST be a list: wg-dns-up.sh calls `resolvectl domain wg0 ...`, which REPLACES the interface list rather than adding to it, so a single-entry value here silently deletes the other two and mcp.diegonmarcos.com falls through to the public edge and its wg_only 403.
